projectObjective: To provide a comprehensive platform for patients to register, book appointments, and manage medical records, while enabling doctors to handle appointments, create EMRs, and process insurance claims efficiently.

functionalRequirements.requirement: Register a new patient account with personal details and optional insurance information.
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Patient receives a confirmation email and can log in immediately after registration.

functionalRequirements.requirement: Login to the system using registered credentials.
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: System authenticates credentials and redirects to patient dashboard.

functionalRequirements.requirement: Search for doctors by specialty, name, or location.
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Search results display doctor profiles with availability status.

functionalRequirements.requirement: Book an appointment with a selected doctor for a specific date and time.
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Appointment request is queued and a notification is sent to the doctor.

functionalRequirements.requirement: Receive appointment requests and view details.
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Doctor can see patient information, requested time, and reason for visit.
Appointment status updates to accepted or rejected and patient is notified.

functionalRequirements.requirement: Create an EMR record after consultation.
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: EMR is linked to the patient and appointment and is stored securely.

functionalRequirements.requirement: Add diagnosis, medicines, and services to the EMR.
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: All entries are validated and saved; EMR can be viewed by the patient.

functionalRequirements.requirement: Generate an insurance claim if the patient has insurance coverage.
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Claim data is compiled from EMR and patient insurance details.

functionalRequirements.requirement: Send the claim to the insurance company via the agreed interface.
functionalRequirements.acceptanceCriteria: Claim is transmitted successfully and a receipt is logged.
Insurance company response updates claim status and notifies the patient and doctor.

nonFunctionalRequirements: The system must be available 99.9% uptime.
All data must be encrypted at rest and in transit.
The application must comply with HIPAA regulations.
The system should support at least 10,000 concurrent users.
Response time for search and booking operations must be under 2 seconds.
The UI must be accessible (WCAG 2.1 AA).
businessRules: Only registered patients can book appointments.
Only doctors with verified credentials can accept appointments.
An appointment can only be booked for a future date and time.
Claims are generated only if the patient has active insurance coverage.
Insurance claims must include diagnosis codes, medication codes, and service codes.
validations: Email must be in a valid format.
Password must be at least 8 characters, include uppercase, lowercase, number, and special character.
Appointment date/time must not be in the past.
Diagnosis, medicine, and service codes must exist in the master code list.
Insurance policy number must be validated against the insurer's database.
assumptions: Patients provide accurate insurance information during registration.
Doctors maintain an up-to-date availability schedule.
Insurance companies expose a RESTful API for claim submission.
The system will integrate with an external email/SMS service for notifications.
clarificationQuestions: What specific fields are required for patient registration beyond basic contact information?
Should patients be able to reschedule or cancel appointments, and if so, what rules apply?
What format and data fields are required by the insurance company for claim submission?
Is there a requirement for patient or doctor portal access via mobile devices?
How should the system handle appointment conflicts if multiple patients request the same slot?
